name: mf_fno_ptr
description: FiLM-transfer winner (mf_fno_transfer_film: LF-pretrain -> HF-finetune over an FiLM-conditioned FNO) PLUS test-time PDE-residual refinement (PTR/NITO). Each de-normalized predicted field u is refined by K Adam steps on the FIELD tensor (not weights) minimizing w_res*||R(u,X,grid)||^2 + w_anchor*||u-u_pred||^2. R comes from a per-dataset residual REGISTRY (refine.py); datasets without an entry get a graceful NO-OP and the family reduces exactly to the winner. Shipped residual is a GENERIC interior-Laplacian-smoothness prior ||Lap u||^2 (documented placeholder, NOT the true operator: the IFC source parameterization from X is not recoverable in this data copy). extra reports nRMSE_pre_refine vs the post-refine headline.
